compiled_state.title: Renumber commit workflow steps to sequential whole numbers
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Testing Mode
UPDATE

## Story DD Coverage
(Scope addition mid-sprint — covers user directive: "renumber steps in the commit workflow to be sequential whole numbers"; supports DD2b's "no unnecessary friction" by improving doc readability)

## Description
After Tasks 73af and 6534 land, COMMIT-WORKFLOW.md and commit-workflow-validation.md have non-sequential step numbering (e.g. Step 0, 0.5, 0.6, 0.9, 1, 4, 6 in COMMIT-WORKFLOW.md; Step 1.5, 2, 3, 3a, 4.5, 5 in commit-workflow-validation.md). Renumber all steps in BOTH files to sequential whole numbers (Step 1, Step 2, Step 3, ...) preserving:

1. **Reading order**: maintain the existing top-to-bottom narrative — only the labels change.
2. **Cross-references**: any `Step N`, `step N`, or `(see Step N)` references inside either file (or in any other file in the repo that references commit workflow steps) must be updated to point at the new numbers. Search the repo with grep for "Step 0.6", "Step 1.5", "Step 3a", "Step 4.5", and the other affected labels and update each callsite.
3. **Anchor links**: if any markdown anchor links (`#step-06`, `#step-15`, etc.) exist, update them to the new labels.
4. **Test references**: tests that grep for step labels (e.g., `test-commit-workflow-step-1-5.sh`) must be updated to grep for the new label OR renamed to match the new convention. Take care to keep the .test-index mapping aligned with any rename.
5. **Plugin script callsites**: scripts under `plugins/dso/` that reference step labels (search with `grep -r "Step [0-9]" plugins/dso/`) must be updated.
6. **Sub-step labels** (e.g., `Step 3a`): treat sub-steps as integer steps in their own right when renumbering — flatten the numbering so every step is a whole integer.

Audit criterion: after renumbering, `grep -E "Step [0-9]+\.[0-9]+|Step [0-9]+[a-z]+" plugins/dso/docs/workflows/COMMIT-WORKFLOW.md plugins/dso/docs/workflows/commit-workflow-validation.md` must return zero lines (no decimal or alphabetic step suffixes remain).

## File Impact
- plugins/dso/docs/workflows/COMMIT-WORKFLOW.md (modify — renumber)
- plugins/dso/docs/workflows/commit-workflow-validation.md (modify — renumber)
- tests/scripts/test-commit-workflow-step-1-5.sh (modify — update assertion to match new step number; rename file if convention requires)
- .test-index (modify — update mapping if test file renamed)
- (search-and-update) any other plugin scripts/docs that reference the old step labels

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass
  Verify: TEST_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.test) && [ -n "$TEST_CMD" ] && $TEST_CMD
- [ ] Lint passes
  Verify: LINT_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.lint) && [ -n "$LINT_CMD" ] && $LINT_CMD
- [ ] Format check passes
  Verify: FORMAT_CHECK_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.format_check) && [ -n "$FORMAT_CHECK_CMD" ] && $FORMAT_CHECK_CMD
- [ ] No fractional or alphabetic step labels remain in either workflow doc
  Verify: test "$(grep -cE 'Step [0-9]+\.[0-9]+|Step [0-9]+[a-z]+' plugins/dso/docs/workflows/COMMIT-WORKFLOW.md plugins/dso/docs/workflows/commit-workflow-validation.md)" -eq 0
- [ ] Steps appear in sequential whole-integer order in COMMIT-WORKFLOW.md (no gaps)
  Verify: bash -c 'nums=$(grep -oE "^## Step [0-9]+" plugins/dso/docs/workflows/COMMIT-WORKFLOW.md | grep -oE "[0-9]+"); prev=0; for n in $nums; do test "$n" -eq $((prev + 1)) || exit 1; prev=$n; done'
- [ ] Steps appear in sequential whole-integer order in commit-workflow-validation.md (no gaps)
  Verify: bash -c 'nums=$(grep -oE "^## Step [0-9]+" plugins/dso/docs/workflows/commit-workflow-validation.md | grep -oE "[0-9]+"); prev=0; for n in $nums; do test "$n" -eq $((prev + 1)) || exit 1; prev=$n; done'
- [ ] Step 1.5 test still passes after renumber + any path/assertion update
  Verify: bash tests/scripts/test-commit-workflow-step-*.sh
- [ ] Referential integrity preserved
  Verify: bash plugins/dso/scripts/check-referential-integrity.sh

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context.
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user.
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet→opus escalation: skip opus, escalate to user immediately.
